applyTo: "src/**/*.tsx,src/**/*.css"

# PropertyGoJB UI

Read `docs/UI_DESIGN_GUIDE.md` before UI implementation. Reuse the applicable
public/auth/account/internal shell and existing shared/domain components.
Read component prop types before use. Match existing semantic theme tokens;
do not invent tokens, component APIs, business data, or status transitions.
Define applicable loading, empty, error, pending, success, and unavailable states.
Verify mobile/desktop layouts, both themes, keyboard/focus behavior, accessible
names and errors, and reduced motion. Report evidence and unverified cases.
Follow the repository SDLC and active business rules; this file grants no
additional permission and does not bypass protected-domain instructions.
